list.definition:
select DISTINCT upm.project_name
from user_project_mapping upm 
join project_mapping pm ON upm.project_name = pm.project_name 
WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.row_id like 'gitlab:%'
and upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY upm.project_name

list.definition:
SELECT CONCAT(r.name, '--', r.id) AS text 
FROM project_mapping pm 
JOIN repos r ON r.id = pm.row_id 
WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.row_id like 'gitlab:%'
AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
ORDER BY text

list.definition:
SELECT Name FROM (
  WITH scoped_repos AS (
    SELECT r.id
    FROM repos r
    WHERE r.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
      AND r.deleted = 0
      AND r.id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                   WHERE pm.row_id  = r.id
                     AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                     AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  ),
  scoped_issues AS (
    -- gitlab board ids match repo ids
    SELECT bi.issue_id
    FROM board_issues bi
    WHERE bi.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                   WHERE pm.row_id  = bi.board_id
                     AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                     AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  ),
  scoped_accounts AS (
    -- MR authors
    SELECT pr.author_id AS account_id, NULL AS fallback_name, 0 AS assignee
    FROM pull_requests pr
    JOIN scoped_repos sr ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
    WHERE pr.author_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    UNION
    -- MR reviewers and commenters
    SELECT cmt.account_id, NULL, 0
    FROM pull_request_comments cmt
    JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = cmt.pull_request_id
    JOIN scoped_repos sr  ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
    WHERE cmt.account_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    UNION
    -- issue assignees, from issue_assignees and issues.assignee_id (the :0 placeholder means unassigned)
    SELECT ia.assignee_id, ia.assignee_name, 1
    FROM issue_assignees ia
    JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = ia.issue_id
    WHERE ia.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    UNION
    SELECT i.assignee_id, i.assignee_name, 1
    FROM issues i
    JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = i.id
    WHERE i.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
      AND i.assignee_id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0'
  )
  -- assignees with no account row keep their GitLab username; bots are left out, unless issues are assigned to them
  SELECT CONCAT(COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), REPLACE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(MAX(sa.fallback_name), _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), '-', ' '), sa.account_id), '--', sa.account_id) AS Name
  FROM scoped_accounts sa
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = sa.account_id
  GROUP BY sa.account_id, a.full_name, a.user_name
  HAVING MAX(sa.assignee) = 1 OR NOT COALESCE(a.user_name, '') LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Unassigned--unassigned'
) all_developers
ORDER BY Name
